name: bg-animate-button
blurb: Button with optional rotating gradient background in six colour schemes.
description: A styled button component that optionally renders a spinning conic-gradient background behind the button text. Supports multiple colour themes (sunset, ocean, nebula, etc.) and animation speeds.
use_when: A primary call-to-action that needs to stand out with colour and motion without being overwhelming.
avoid_when: When accessibility is paramount or the UI needs to stay minimal and calm.
a11y: Standard button element with full keyboard support. Uses text children so the label is always accessible.
